_comment: Event-level rules: connect an event of a given type, involving given entities, to a variable even when the article does not name that variable. sign_source FIXED uses effect_sign; PRIMARY_EFFECT uses the direction the article reported for primary_effect_variable (unknown -> context-dependent).

triggers.mechanism: The reported tariff action changes the US tariff rate applied to Chinese goods.
triggers.note: Assumes the action raises tariffs; a reported tariff cut/rollback is handled via the article's primary effect instead.

triggers.mechanism: Conflict or escalation in the region raises perceived geopolitical risk.
triggers.note: De-escalation news would reverse the sign; the article's primary effect overrides this trigger when present.

triggers.mechanism: Attacks or threats near key chokepoints disrupt shipping routes.
New sanctions increase restrictions on Russian trade and finance.
triggers.note: Sanctions relief would reverse the sign.

triggers.mechanism: The Federal Reserve sets the federal funds target range.
The RBI Monetary Policy Committee sets the repo rate.
OPEC+ sets production quotas for member states.
